messages:
matt: FYI found a partner artifact in S3 with a KMS-wrapped service account blob. file: partner-upload-2026-03-21.tar.gz. looks like someone accidentally checked a wrapped SA JSON into logs. no plaintext creds found so far.

katie: staging or prod? any active tokens in that SA?

matt: appears to be staging but the SA has org-level roles (bigquery.viewer, storage.objectViewer). I grepped the blob, it's a KMS ciphertext header and a short b64 payload. sample header: 
```
{"ciphertext":"CiQA...Zx==","format":"gcp-kms-v1","key":"projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/partner/cryptoKeys/sa-wrap"}
```

david: ok, thanks. treat as credential exposure. triage plan: 1) containment: prevent further use of the SA 2) scope: find all artifacts referencing that SA 3) recovery: issue new, minimal SA and rewrap secrets 4) cleanup: rotate keys / re-encrypt and update partner.

sara: oncall here — I'll run auditor queries and temporarily restrict the SA bindings. running: `gcloud iam service-accounts disable partner-sa@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com` then blocking any OAuth tokens. will also flip audit-level logging for KMS + iam.

matt: noted. I can grep internal caches and our CI logs for the SA email. timeline: 30m for initial scope.

david: decision: do NOT just rewrap with the same cryptoKey version. create a new CryptoKey (or new keyRing version) and re-encrypt artifacts where possible. rationale: reduce blast radius and preserve audit trail.

alex: devops chiming in — we'll need to coordinate with the partner for an out-of-band key rollover. prefer a maintenance window. I can prepare a service account replacement script and an automation to patch secrets in Vault and GH actions.

katie: list of concrete actions we should track in the ticket?

david: capture these as checklist (short):
- [ ] disable exposed SA (owner: sara)
- [ ] create replacement SA with least-priv (owner: alex)
- [ ] generate new KMS CryptoKey (owner: david)
- [ ] re-encrypt wrapped blobs with new key (owner: alex)
- [ ] push new wrapped blobs to partner and rotate their pointers (owner: matt)
- [ ] revoke any suspicious OAuth tokens / keys (owner: sara)
- [ ] update Vault/KV references and per-route RBAC to narrow access (owner: alex)
- [ ] run regressive audit and long-term logging (owner: katie)

sara: I've disabled the SA and created an audit snapshot at `gs://redwood-audit/snapshots/1711113000.json` — sec-oncall-bot also posted the entry.

sec-oncall-bot: Audit snapshot created: gs://redwood-audit/snapshots/1711113000.json. Triggered rule: partner-sa-exposed.

matt: for re-encrypt, recommend these commands as a reference (non-blocking, we'll wrap in automation):
```
# create new key
gcloud kms keys create partner-rollover-key --location=global --keyring=partner --purpose=encryption
# encrypt with new key
echo -n "$(cat exposed-sa.json.enc)" | base64 --decode | gcloud kms encrypt --location=global --keyring=partner --key=partner-rollover-key --plaintext-file=- --ciphertext-file=- | base64
# vault update
vault write secret/data/partner/sa value=@new-wrapped-blob.json
```

david: also add a Vault transit rewrap flow if partner uses `transit/rewrap`. example: `vault write -f transit/rewrap/partner-key ciphertext=<old>` then replace. ensure audit-enabled on Vault before writes.

katie: how do we handle RBAC tightening? I suggest creating a temporary IAM condition on the old SA binding to deny network access until partner confirms rotation.

sara: ack. I'll push a conditional deny rule for 48h: `deny` for principals with the exposed SA when sourceIP not in our maintenance-range.

alex: partner coordination: I'll open a JIRA and ask for a 2-hour window tonight. once they confirm we run the scripted roll, patch Vault, and validate app smoke tests.

david: post-rotation validation: run end-to-end smoke on main routes + verify token issuance and KMS decrypt success against new key. also fetch audit logs for 24h pre/post and snapshot.

matt: assigning owners in Jira now. I'll push a short remediation note to the partner slack channel and send the wrapped blob replacement instructions.

katie: can someone verify we rotated any compute metadata tokens that might have used the SA?

sara: on it. going to list all VM/Cloud Run instances in staging with the SA attached and schedule a quick restart after patch.

david: I'll own the final postmortem and ensure lessons learned (RBAC least privilege, retention/scan rules, prevent wrapped blobs in partner archives).

alex: On the automation side, I'll add a pre-commit CI hook to fail builds that include `projects/.*/cryptoKeys`-like patterns and a scanning job to run weekly.

matt: thanks team. I'll keep this thread updated with JIRA link and timestamped artifacts. :thumbsup:

sara: update 1711115400 — partner confirmed window at 22:00 UTC. alex will execute.

alex: update 1711115800 — re-encrypt + vault writes complete, smoke tests green. opened followup for long-term RBAC pruning.

katie: closing loop: send final audit snapshot and PM to infra for policy change. good job everyone. :tada:
